args.command:
{
  echo "=== AgentScribe Sessions Directory Listing ==="
  echo "Generated: $(date)"
  echo ""
  echo "=== Top-level directories ==="
  ls -la ~/.agentscribe/sessions/
  echo ""
  echo "=== Aider sessions ==="
  ls -la ~/.agentscribe/sessions/aider/ | head -10
  echo "File count: $(ls -1 ~/.agentscribe/sessions/aider/ | wc -l)"
  echo ""
  echo "=== Claude Code sessions ==="
  ls -la ~/.agentscribe/sessions/claude-code/ | head -10
  echo "File count: $(ls -1 ~/.agentscribe/sessions/claude-code/ | wc -l)"
  echo ""
  echo "=== Total session files ==="
  find ~/.agentscribe/sessions/ -type f | wc -l
  echo ""
  echo "=== Disk usage ==="
  du -sh ~/.agentscribe/sessions/
} > /tmp/agentscribe_sessions_listing.txt
